inputs.text: What you are about to hear is fiction. Waterlinie Care Group does not exist; the names, the conversations and the incidents were built for a fraud risk assessment. Eight roles from the risk control matrix were each asked one question, separately: which control fails on your side, and why? Their answers are laid out here on a single timeline, as a group chat.
Monday, the twenty-sixth of January. Payroll is still catching up after an underpayment incident.
The roster never matches LoonLink anyway, so I just sort it out myself.
[warmly] I'll just submit it the way I always do. You don't look at the end date anyway.
[laughs] Those hundred and twelve old accounts, I'll clear them out next sprint. Promise.
None of those three sentences is a lie. The correction flow that grew out of that incident simply never got a control.
Thursday, the twelfth of February. Quarter-end close.
Let's wrap up the last entries a bit faster this quarter. The board wants clean figures by Friday.
[calm, unhurried] Let's tidy up the annual figures nicely before the audit. Then we won't have to restate anything later.
